codeSnapshot: Reading Room source inspected 18 October 2026; point-in-time capability inventory.

currentCapabilities.search: URL candidate bypasses paid search; exact-ish original query then stopword-reduced fallback, 4–200 headline characters, publisher domain restriction, up to 8 results, 30 searches/room/day. Search results never prove readability.
currentCapabilities.libraryMatching: Normalized token overlap (not semantic fuzzy search), score >=0.72 and runner-up gap >=0.12, date penalty 0.35; NewsBank document URL validation. Times/London Telegraph publication checks in HTTP adapter.
currentCapabilities.media: Public readable HTML adapter may extract article-contained media; Times photo recovery not demonstrated by this slice.

fixtureTests.type: deterministic synthetic fixture tests, not live retrieval

liveValidation: A later ordinary authenticated AWS-hosted library-service lookup returned the verified France-protests article from The Sunday Telegraph (London, UK), with 51 paragraphs. The new 18 October politics article was not found both in the phone screenshot and in an ordinary authenticated service lookup. The v40 phone retest still had no Times image. BBC readability was owner-confirmed. Post-v41 phone retesting remains pending; service retrieval is not phone acceptance.
nextSteps: Authenticate ordinary Camden NewsBank title browser and record source IDs, coverage dates, formats and current availability before enabling any additional library title.
Prioritise Guardian/Independent/Standard existing public adapters; extend explicit NewsBank publication source mapping for each title only after observed entitlement.
Treat Observer current domain and archive identities separately; never silently alias it to Guardian.
For Financial Times record current embargo/availability from authenticated source information; do not infer same-day from daily collection refresh.
Add Mail/Mirror/Sun dedicated public profiles only after bounded official-page fixtures and source-boundary checks.
For magazines verify Camden issue entitlement and supported readable capture format first; TIME has indexed catalogue evidence, Economist only provider evidence, Statesman/Prospect unresolved.

Use exact publisher+headline+date first; fuzzy variants return candidates for review and reject ties, wrong source, wrong date and unsafe URLs. Expand tests for very short headlines, accented titles and ambiguous editions.

latestValidation.method: Ordinary authenticated AWS-hosted library-service lookup with an authorised account; no browser-state transfer or access bypass. Only result metadata is recorded here.
